question: Should maintainers keep this MiMo Discord report as a separate security-sensitive reproduction until payload proof lands, or fold it into the older Discord reasoning-leak issue now?
rationale: The observable outcome is clear, but the current source and related reports leave multiple plausible boundaries, and the closest open PR was previously reviewed as missing the affected delivery extractor.

options.title: Keep separate until payload proof
options.body: Keep this issue open, capture a redacted current-main MiMo Discord payload trace, then decide whether it is the same root cause as the older Discord leak.

options.title: Fold into older Discord leak
options.body: Close this as a duplicate of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96849 and preserve the MiMo details there, accepting some root-cause uncertainty.

options.title: Sponsor the open candidate PR
options.body: Ask the author of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96969 to repair the embedded delivery extractor gap and add real Discord proof before treating it as canonical.

recommendation.title: Keep separate until payload proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, capture a redacted current-main MiMo Discord payload trace, then decide whether it is the same root cause as the older Discord leak.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent overlap across Discord reasoning delivery and OpenAI-compatible reasoning handling.
